mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline ≥0.05% over prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate rise above 5.5% signals economic weakness, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline ≥0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals easing supply constraints, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as equity markets react to improving fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST increases ≥0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 3.5% annually signals persistent price pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual rate exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent payroll declines and unemployment rate increases signal labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises ≥0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below -0.3% monthly indicates worsening supply chain disruptions, reducing corporate output and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in <40% of periods when INDPRO growth is below -0.3% monthly.
